rationale.headline: Both Advocate Health deals are Healthcare Services stock deals, and a $200M target sits inside its $135.5-336.0M range.
rationale.acquirer_overview: Strategic acquirer: 2 deals in 2020-2022, 1 in the last 3 years, most deals in Healthcare Services (2), size sweet spot $135.5-336.0M (IQR), buying from Private sellers in 2 of 2 deals and paying in Stock in 2 of 2. Its history points to private Healthcare Services targets, spread across Northeast and Southwest, with a median target margin of 17.9%.
rationale.strategic_fit_thesis: The target is core-sized for Advocate Health, inside its interquartile range of $135.5-336.0M, and both of its closed deals are Healthcare Services [MA-2020-0496][MA-2022-0311]. On footprint, it has one Northeast deal and one Southwest deal, so a regional target would extend one of these or add a third geography. Versus closest competitor Ardent Health Services, the difference is size: Advocate has 1 closed deal in the size band against 0 for Ardent, and a median deal size of $235.8M against $94.1M, so the target is core-sized for Advocate but a stretch for Ardent. Vertical integration and overlap are not evidenced, and the data shows no antitrust signal. The deal labels (Strategic Acquisition, Leveraged Buyout, Diversification) are noisy, so the thesis does not rest on them. Financing is Stock in both deals, so there is no evidence of cash or debt capacity beyond that.

precedent_activity.why_relevant: Closed $436.2M Northeast Healthcare Services deal from a Private seller, paid in Stock at 9.3x EV/EBITDA; usable as a control comp and its only relevant closed deal in the size band.
Closed $35.3M Southwest Healthcare Services deal at 13.8x EV/EBITDA, its most recent deal (2022); far smaller than the target, so only a sector and seller-type reference.

rationale.valuation_context: Advocate Health's only comparable closed control deal, [MA-2020-0496], priced at 9.3x EV/EBITDA and 2.04x EV/revenue. Against Strategic peers, whose median is 14.2x (n=30), it pays below its peers. The smaller [MA-2022-0311] was 13.8x, so the pricing evidence is thin at n=1 comp. A seller with a 21.5% margin may push for more than this buyer's history, where targets had a median margin of 17.9%.

risk_flags.detail: Pricing position is below Strategic peers (9.3x against a 14.2x peer median), based on a single comp [MA-2020-0496]; a 21.5% margin seller may reject this buyer's price level.
Average bidders across its two deals is 4.5 (5 on [MA-2020-0496], 4 on [MA-2022-0311]), flagged as high competition, so it may be outbid.
Thin and aging evidence: only 2 deals, 1 in the last 3 years, last deal in 2022, and 0 recent closed deals in the size band.

conviction.rationale: Kept at the suggested Low: only 2 deals, 1 relevant closed deal in band, none recent in band, and pricing below peers at 9.3x versus 14.2x. Offsets are a core-sized fit and no withdrawn deals.
